That first night

I saw you across the room and something shifted. The neon heart hanging there felt like the universe putting up a sign. You were in that pink dress and I remember thinking — I want to know everything about this person. Two months later, I still think that every single day.

✨

These two months

Two months of good mornings and late-night calls. Two months of learning the way you laugh, the way you think, the way you make everything feel warmer just by being in it. Two months of realising I want this — you — for every month that follows.

💜

What I know now

I know that meeting you was the best thing to happen to me. I know that missing you is proof of how much space you have taken up in my life — and I do not want that space back. I know I am the luckiest person in that photo. Happy 2 months, my Adhya.
